name: DatePicker
description: Selects a date or date range from a calendar.

dependencies.name: react-day-picker
dependencies.reason: Optional — renders the calendar popup; the trigger and form field work without it.

value.description: Controlled value: Date | null in single mode, DateRange | null in range mode

defaultValue.description: Initial value for uncontrolled use, typed by mode

onValueChange.description: Called with the new value, typed by mode: (date: Date | null) in single mode, (range: DateRange | null) in range mode

readOnly.description: Shows the value with a dashed edge; the calendar stays shut

format.description: Formats one date for the trigger. Defaults to Intl in the locale (long for single, medium for each range end); ranges join with an en dash

label.description: Visible label text above the date picker

helperText.description: Helper text shown below the date picker

invalid.description: Marks the value invalid: the danger edge, aria-invalid and the error message

errorMessage.description: Words shown under the trigger while invalid, with a warning icon

when: A date the user picks off a calendar
A start and end date together
whenNot: Time on its own (use a dedicated TimePicker)
A handful of known dates (use Select)
Typed date entry (use Input with a date mask)
guidelines: Pair range mode with numberOfMonths={2} so both ends are visible
size="sm" lines the trigger up with other dense toolbar controls
Offer at most a few presets for the common ranges: Today, Last 7 days, Last 30 days
disabledDates blocks past or unavailable days before the user tries
Placeholder names the date, not the action
A single pick closes the calendar at once; a range stays open until Escape or an outside click
DatePicker.Trigger defaults to type="button", so it is safe inside a form
accessibility: The visible label names the trigger, followed by the current value (aria-labelledby)
Helper and error text describe the trigger (aria-describedby); invalid sets aria-invalid
The calendar grid is fully keyboard navigable; arrow keys move between days
Escape closes the calendar and focus returns to the trigger
Read-only keeps the trigger focusable but holds the calendar shut

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Trigger opens one month; today carries the strong line.

examples.name: Controlled
examples.code:
const [date, setDate] = React.useState<Date | null>(null);

<DatePicker label="Start date" value={date} onValueChange={setDate}>
  <DatePicker.Trigger />
  <DatePicker.Content>
    <DatePicker.Calendar />
  </DatePicker.Content>
</DatePicker>

examples.name: Small Trigger
examples.description: Matches the height of other sm toolbar controls.

examples.name: Date Range
examples.description: Two months side by side so both ends of the range are visible.

examples.name: Disabled Dates
examples.description: Days before today are struck through and unclickable.
examples.code:
<DatePicker
  label="Ships on"
  placeholder="Select a future date"
  disabledDates={(date) => date < new Date(new Date().setHours(0, 0, 0, 0))}
>
  <DatePicker.Trigger />
  <DatePicker.Content>
    <DatePicker.Calendar />
  </DatePicker.Content>
</DatePicker>

examples.name: With Presets
examples.description: A few ghost buttons above the calendar skip the common ranges.
examples.code:
const today = new Date(2026, 9, 4);
const weekAgo = new Date(2026, 8, 28);

<DatePicker mode="range" label="Window" numberOfMonths={2}>
  <DatePicker.Trigger />
  <DatePicker.Content>
    <DatePicker.Preset range={{ from: today, to: today }}>Today</DatePicker.Preset>
    <DatePicker.Preset range={{ from: weekAgo, to: today }}>Last 7 days</DatePicker.Preset>
    <DatePicker.Calendar />
  </DatePicker.Content>
</DatePicker>

examples.name: With Helper Text
examples.description: Label above the trigger, supporting text below it.
examples.code:
<DatePicker
  label="Renewal date"
  placeholder="Pick a date"
  helperText="Billing restarts on this day each month."
>
  <DatePicker.Trigger />
  <DatePicker.Content>
    <DatePicker.Calendar />
  </DatePicker.Content>
</DatePicker>

examples.name: Invalid
examples.description: The danger edge on the trigger, and the reason below it with an icon.
examples.code:
<DatePicker
  label="Start date"
  placeholder="Pick a date"
  invalid
  errorMessage="Pick a start date before the end date"
>
  <DatePicker.Trigger />
  <DatePicker.Content>
    <DatePicker.Calendar />
  </DatePicker.Content>
</DatePicker>

examples.name: Read Only
examples.description: The value with a dashed edge; the calendar stays shut.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.description: Dimmed; the calendar will not open.
examples.code:
<DatePicker label="Start date" placeholder="Pick a date" disabled>
  <DatePicker.Trigger />
  <DatePicker.Content>
    <DatePicker.Calendar />
  </DatePicker.Content>
</DatePicker>

relations.note: Use Select for choosing from a list of options
Use Input for free-form text date entry
DatePicker uses Popover for the calendar dropdown

propsSummary: value / defaultValue: Date | null (single) or DateRange | null (range)
label: string - visible label text, names the trigger
helperText: string - helper text below field
invalid: boolean + errorMessage: string - danger edge, aria-invalid and message
readOnly: boolean - value shown, calendar held shut
format: (date) => string - one formatter; Intl by locale otherwise; ranges join with an en dash
DatePicker.Trigger: button props supported (type defaults to "button")
